描述_EN: the emperor believed that these fine steeds would carry him safely to paradise. it was emperor wudi (reigned 140-87 bc) who first sent expeditions into central asia to fetch back 'blood-sweating' horses. during the tang dynasty (618-907) important tombs were sure to include models of these desirable animals. this magnificent model of a horse attests to the passion of the chinese for beautiful pure-bred animals from the west. this model shows the skills of tang dynasty potters.
描述_ZN: 皇帝相信这些优良的骏马会把他安全地带到天堂。 是武帝（公元前140-87年在位）第一次派人到中亚去取回 "流血 "的马匹。 在唐代（618-907），重要的墓葬中肯定会有这些理想的动物模型。 这个宏伟的马的模型证明了中国人对来自西方的美丽的纯种动物的热情。 这个模型显示了唐代陶工的技能。
